a1Stacks.label: Disciplinary Action, six stacks
a1Stacks.reason: She gains a stack each time she uses Windborne Sword or her Burst, so the six that raise her Spirit Blades build up during the fight.

skillArmed.label: Armed for Action
skillArmed.reason: Her Normal Attacks are Anemo only in Armed for Action mode, which she leaves after a few Windborne Swords, and her main damage comes from her Skill and Burst.

party.reason: Most teams set up no Stellar reaction. Her Spirit Blades deal their ordinary damage only then and their Stellar Swirl damage in its place when the team sets one up, so the Stellar Swirl hits are not counted unless the team is chosen.
